scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w infra
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w infra
scripts.lint:strict: npm run lint:strict -w client && npm run lint:strict -w server && npm run lint:strict -w infra
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w infra
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w infra
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w client && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run build -w client && playwright test --headed
scripts.quality:pr: npm run format:check && npm run audit:prod && npm run lint:strict && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.quality:main: npm run quality:pr && npm run test:e2e && npm run doctor
scripts.deploy: ([ -f server/src/data/countries.json ] || npm run generate -w server) && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w infra && npm run deploy -w infra
